notes.title: Land Drifters: Side activities
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome![/h1]

[h2]Progress[/h2]
I know some people are eager to play and we know that feeling! We're working on it (it's just two of us), but at the same time we don't want to rush it and release it too early. The game is coming along nicely, we're doing another internal play through to help iron out any bugs or tweak the balance. There's still some things we still want to get done before the release. 

We are still aiming to release it later this year.

[h2]Side Activities[/h2]
What's an update without a sneak peek? I wanted to show some side activities in the game that we have. When you reach new destinations, you also will discover new points of interest. Some might even be a little fun game!

[i]Zombie Blaster[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/D484iS7.gif[/img]
These games are just little side activities you can choose to participate in if you want to give yourself something to do while you are busy collecting your resources or crafting weapons to slay some monsters. 

These games have scaling difficulty and experience for their section. Clearing higher levels will get you more cosmetic points quicker and even unlock some fun rewards!

[i]Avatar Customization[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZOOUjD2.png[/img]
You can customize your avatar and background that is used in combat along with other things. You also will unlock any items you upgrade from the altar with your essence as well!

[i]Unlocking Cosmetics[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fzTGw3G.png[/img]
These activities are not required to do, but can offer some fun cosmetics to earn in game.

[i]Number Dash[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5p2JRhH.gif[/img]
Some of these games can get pretty intensive as well at the higher levels if you find them fun!

notes.title: Land Drifters - Welcome to 2025
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4kC5aN9.png[/img]

[h1]Welcome to the new year![/h1]

It's been awhile since the last update but we're still hard at work and making good progress and the game is coming out this year!

[h2]Sneak Peek[/h2]

Let's talk about crafting!

In Land Drifters, you can not only level your crafting skills, but there are also masteries with each skill. The more you work with iron, the better you get at it of course!

With this, each new area feels fresh again with new masteries to level up at a quick pace. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CDbrWm9.png[/img]

In this picture, you'll notice there is a smelting mastery, along with working with metals such as copper and iron. Crafting iron items will provide experience to blacksmithing (Red Bar) as well as to your iron mastery (Green Bar) at an accelerated rate.

If you ever get stuck trying to defeat the new enemies, no worries, as you hone your mastery, you can learn to make even higher quality gear to help you overcome them if needed!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kASCz9Q.png[/img]

Each tier will have vastly improved stats over the previous ones if you get your mastery higher!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KU205fd.gif[/img]
You can even click to give things a little more "oomph" if you're in a rush to try that new weapon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bZHmvzu.gif[/img]
The same with smelting.

There are many more crafting skills to explore and master!

notes.title: Land Drifters - Progression and Sneak Peek
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've been working on finishing up the last island and polishing/balancing lately so the news updates have been a little sparse, but progress is being made and we plan to release it sometime later this year.

With that said, here's a bit of a sneak peak. (Subject to change!)

In the top left, we have these energy bars.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5VYup9P.gif[/img]

The red one is essence which is used for upgrades. These aren't required for progression, but just adds something extra to do. With each enemy you beat, you get essence. Get enough and you can upgrade any item type permanently. With each unique item upgrade, the item gets some stats, you unlock the item cosmetic for customization, and your max essence increases by one allowing you to store more or do higher tiers of upgrades! This can give an incentive to gather many different items to increase your essence cap or try and unlock all the item cosmetics or even help you beat a boss you are struggling on.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZtJxN5G.gif[/img]

Below the essence bar, we have energy bars for different combat class styles to help with class diversity, however if you become skilled in a trait, it can potentially help you in other combat styles, you just might not be able to train it to higher levels when working on a different class.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bVTVteK.png[/img]

In the overworld, you'll explore and unlock new places or features which can give you access to new things. For gathering, you might reach a destination like this

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kcZqEX7.png[/img]

Then enter and get a similarly looking themed gathering area like so:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/J02lc4i.png[/img]

You'll notice that there are two levels for gathering. One is the zone level, the other is the skill itself. When you reach a new zone for the first time, you might be good at mining, but inexperienced at the area. As you level up in mining or in the zone itself, you unlock new points to put into your choice of talents. As you can imagine, the mining talents will affect everywhere regarding mining, whereas the points in that zone are specific to just that zone.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MhQbD6Z.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n48ZZ2O.png[/img]

notes.title: Land Drifters - Hello Everyone
notes.notes:
[h1]Land Drifters[/h1]

[h1]Early Access[/h1]
We're working hard to get this game out to you in a timely manner, but at the same time we want the game to be in a good place before it's released. While it will come out as Early Access, we want it to feel nice and polished, keep your saved data, earn achievements, and more on Early Access launch.

[h1]Roadmap to Release[/h1]
We have islands in our game that are broken into a few phases each. Currently we're working on the third island and when that is in a good state, we'd like to release a video trailer for the game and start talking about our game more as we enter the polishing state to get ready for release. It's hard to give a time estimate because we don't know either but we're starting to see the light at the end of the tunnel and it should be in the coming months. We'll let you know as soon as we know!
